name: ShortcutHelpDialog
description: Searchable, grouped list of the registered commands and their keys, in Kbd; with `rebind`, each can be changed.
signature: ({ title, rebind, groupOrder, open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange }: ShortcutHelpDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: groupOrder
props.description: Group headings in this order; groups not listed follow in registration order.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state and Base UI change details (the reason; `details.cancel()` keeps it open) when the trigger, Esc, an outside press, a close control or a sheet swipe opens or dismisses it. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: rebind
props.description: Let the person change keys. Each change reaches the provider's `onKeymapChange`.
